name: GHRP-6

lead: GHRP-6 is a synthetic hexapeptide from the first generation of growth hormone releasing peptides. It was a research tool in the 1980s and 1990s and is now sold as a research chemical.
It is known for raising growth hormone and also for a strong hunger effect. Human evidence of improved muscle or appearance has not been published.

paras: GHRP-6 activates the ghrelin receptor, causing growth hormone release and appetite stimulation, and also raises cortisol and prolactin somewhat.
It is not approved for human use and is banned in sport. Reported effects include intense hunger, water retention and flushing. Long-term safety is unknown and quality is unregulated.
